tagline: A calm, residential Asian side district between Maltepe and Kartal — good transport links, an honest local café scene, and a quieter pace suited to everyday living.

items.name: Cevizli Semt Kafeleri
items.description: A cluster of neighbourhood cafés around the Cevizli metro station. Reliable daily coffee spots popular with commuters and locals.

items.name: Cevizli Lokantalari
items.description: Honest lokanta restaurants serving rotating daily menus at very local prices. Solid home-style Turkish cooking.

items.name: Maltepe Sahil (yakın)
items.description: The Maltepe waterfront park is just a short ride away — one of the best coastal promenades on the Asian side.

tips: Cevizli has its own Marmaray station — Kadıköy is about 20 minutes, with the M4 at nearby Maltepe.
Very affordable to live here compared to Kadıköy or Moda — popular with young professionals.
Quieter and more residential than Maltepe or Kartal, but with the same metro access.
The nearby coastal park is a 10-minute walk — worth the stroll in good weather.
